name: The Lantern Bishop
place: dungeon crypt_spiral SET B: the central vault of the last floor (30-34 m square)
_doc: Stream E (M2). End boss of crypt set B: a bishop who hoards light. Four tall mirrors stand in the vault — they block his Glare (line of sight) and in P3 his beams BOUNCE OFF THEM (lines fired from each standing mirror). P1 'Benediction': a cone, a rotating cross of light, the Glare. P2 at 60% 'Darkened Nave': he puts out the three lanterns and hides in a shield of stolen light while hounds come; light the lanterns again to break it — and he keeps reaching for their light (a soak at every lantern: stand on it or take the hit together). P3 is a new health bar 'Last Rites': mirror beams, a three-player stack, a pull-in-and-out ring, and grave-water safe spots.
party: Solo: very hard (the lantern soaks need a body each) — bring a follower and accept soak failures. 2-3: the intended size; one lights lanterns while one tanks. 5: easy soaks, crowded mirrors. M5 scaling: lantern soak count = min(party, 3); adds 2 -> 1 solo.

pull: Come into the light, children. All of it. Every last drop.
You brought a torch? How generous. I'll take it.
say.death: The Bishop's robes collapse in a heap of ash and very bright dust. Somewhere, a candle relights itself.
say.reset: The Bishop turns back to his mirrors, admiring the glow.

enrage.say: THEN I WILL TAKE THE LIGHT FROM YOUR EYES.

cross_of_light.name: Cross of Light
cross_of_light.say: Light splits the vault into four!

glare.name: Lantern Glare
glare.say: The Bishop lifts his lantern high — get behind a mirror!

steal_light.name: Steal the Light
steal_light.say: He reaches for the lanterns' light — stand under every lantern!

telegraphs.failSay: A lantern's light pours into the Bishop and burns everyone!

procession.name: Night Procession
procession.say: Hounds pad out of the dark aisles.

last_rites.name: Last Rites
last_rites.say: {target} is chosen for the last rites — three of you, stand together!

halo.name: Burning Halo
halo.say: A halo of fire spreads out from him — get in close!

phases.name: Darkened Nave
phases.say: Darkness, my children. Let me hold the light for you.

onEnter.say: The lanterns go dark and a shell of stolen light closes around the Bishop. Light all three lanterns!

phases.name: Last Rites
phases.say: You gave it back to them? Then burn in it.

do.say: Three lanterns blaze! The shell of light cracks and the Bishop reels!
Every mirror lies in pieces. Nowhere left to hide from the light!
